name: Political Matrix / The Listener Group (Palafox Media Network)

poll.source_locator: Section 'U.S. Senate Special Election: Moody Holds Clearer Edge': 'Moody leads Democrat Angie Nixon 41.8 percent to 35.8 percent, with 22.4 percent undecided'
poll.notes: Among decided voters Moody 53.8, Nixon 46.2. New pollster; no prior record. Release quotes staff from both a 'Democratic Campaigns' and a Republican-side strategist, so alignment left UNKNOWN. Release undated on the page; methodology is one line ('500 recorded responses from likely Florida voters', MOE +/-4.38%); no mode or weighting disclosed.
